messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — ArgusCorp reported a regression on Dedicated when we autoscale up. After the cluster adds a node and we warm a new replica, subsequent requests for the same session start including repeated 'TIP:' lines and occasionally duplicate short completions. Repro steps below.

Sam P (PM): Thanks Maya. Severity? Customer impact and whether it's causing incorrect outputs or just duplicates? Also any sample request ids?

Maya (CS): Impact: 3 customers reported, Argus hit it in prod (non-blocking but high cost). Behavior is incorrect token duplication and occasional safety flags triggered by repeated prefixes. Sample request id: r-0a1b2c3d. Repro steps:
```
# reproduce against Argus dedicated pool
curl -s -X POST "https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Customer-ID: arguscorp" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-instruct","version":"v2.4.1","session_id":"argus-test-123","input":"Summarize the invoice."}'
# send 50 short requests at t=0..30s to trigger autoscale
```
Observed: first 10 responses fine, after autoscale you see repeated 'TIP:' prefix and some completions duplicated.

Liam (Eng): Can you paste the runtime logs around r-0a1b2c3d and the node join logs? Also which runtime build/commit and quantization profile?

Maya (CS): Attaching snippets:
```
[2026-02-18T14:12:32Z] node-12 joining pool
[2026-02-18T14:12:35Z] model-load redwood-7b-instruct v2.4.1 quant: q4_0 ok
[2026-02-18T14:12:36Z] kv_cache_mismatch: session argus-test-123 found stale prefix len=42 expected=0
[2026-02-18T14:12:36Z] emit: "TIP: To help..."
[2026-02-18T14:12:36Z] duplicate_chunk_detected: seq(45) previously_emitted true
```

Nora (SRE): Looks like KV cache state wasn't reset/rehomed correctly on the new replica. Could be a race in our prefix reconciliation during model warmup. Maya — can you collect full trace with span ids? Use trace_id r-0a1b2c3d.

Maya (CS): Done. Trace uploaded to S3 link: https://s3.internal/redwood/argus/r-0a1b2c3d/trace.json

Liam (Eng): Thanks — assigning to eng-runtime backlog, label=bug, priority=P2. Tentative triage: possible fix options — 1) on node join force KV prefix validation & clear on mismatch, 2) make warmup atomic so runtime rejects requests until replica is consistent. I'll circle back after I reproduce locally.

Sam P (PM): Add to next planning sync. Need launch criteria: reproduction in staging, unit/regression test added, no perf regression under burst, and rollout plan with canary. Flagging for Dedicated reliability initiative.

deploy-bot: ticket #INFR-482 created and linked to thread.

Liam (Eng): I'll try to repro in the infra lab today. If anyone else sees this in other customers, please drop request ids.

Maya (CS): Noted. I'll consolidate affected customers and ping sales for impact. :thumbsup:
